definitions.kpi_a: process documents (REPORTS + PATTERNS + docs + investigations .md files) per DONE ledger row
definitions.kpi_a_narrow: as kpi_a, but counting only REPORTS + PATTERNS
definitions.kpi_b_bytes: bytes of .agent/00_BOOT.md (the cost of one boot read)
definitions.kpi_b_tokens_est: boot bytes / 4 - an ESTIMATE; the tokeniser is unknown
definitions.kpi_c: commits per day on the working branch, counted over the days that have at least one GREEN gate capture; the coverage is reported with it
definitions.gate_green_rule: a capture is RED if it reports a failed class, a failed tooling probe, or an ERROR line; GREEN if it reports Verification passed and no red signal; UNKNOWN otherwise
definitions.deliberate_red: a capture whose file name carries -RED is deliberate red-then-green evidence, not a failure; it is counted separately from a red capture with no -RED in its name
definitions.process_document: a Markdown file under .agent/REPORTS/, .agent/PATTERNS/, docs/ or investigations/
